relation: nat equality: the four unordered counts (chromatic XE1, X76, X78 over M1 aliases of sg_edge_set; D2ram over E(G)) convert to edge_count; the three enum-rank oriented pair selectors (X5, X4, D2tur through base oedge) equal it by GTBase.common.edge_count_rank, unconditionally.
summary: Batch A, family A7 (undirected edge count). Seven count helpers now unfold to `GTBase.common.edge_count G := #|E(G)|`. Chromatic XE1, X76 and X78 counted M1's alias edge sets and D2ram counted `E(G)`, so they convert; X5, X4 and D2tur (through base `oedge`) counted adjacent ordered pairs with `enum_rank p.1 < enum_rank p.2`, which `edge_count_rank` proves equal to the edge count unconditionally (adjacent vertices are distinct and the rank order selects exactly one orientation). Thirty-five statements are affected (X5, D2ram, two D2tur, four X4, X76, X78, X88, X96, eight extremal XE1 and fifteen extremal XE2 rows) through ten intermediate predicates: D2ram's common-graph and D2tur's Turan-number chains, X4's Turan number, five XE1 chains (size Ramsey and its number, every-k-set sparsity, the Turan number of a graph and its minimum over sizes) and two XE2 chains (saturated planar, incident-chord extremal). Helper certificates are nat equalities; chain and statement certificates transport them by setoid rewriting through the unchanged texts.

History: 34 earlier frozen declarations (A2 #613/#742, B2 #915, A5's XE1/XE2/X78/X96 rows and Turan chains, A6's five Ramsey rows, B4's c5/#567/incident-chord, C7's #1080) still call live A7 names and are documented below. Complete Originals: X76Original and X78Original have pre-M1 counts (bodies at 061154c over M1's frozen comprehension; X78 also with A5's frozen subgraph helper), but their rows keep the live M1 aliases through the unmigrated cut sizes (the planned A9 family). X4Original (B4), X96Original (A5), XE1Original (two Turan chains and six rows, with A5/A6/B4) and XE2Original (the incident-chord chain and ten rows, with A2/B2/A5/A6/B4/C7) are the 9e03072 texts. #567 keeps the live x4_edge_set through B4's frozen h5_graph, and #613/#742 through A2's frozen predicates. The other 15 Original rows and the five Original chains reach no M1 alias (Print All Dependencies at 526ad18). D2ram's prose/ledger discrepancy (PARTIAL in prose, done in the ledger) is preserved and reported separately. No statement text, guard, doc block, manifest row, leg state or status changes.

B8 history (follow-up on the private merge with B8 e377dcb): XE2PathEdgesOriginal.erdos_915_statement is the complete pre-B2/A7/B8 #915 over B2's frozen internal disjointness, B8's frozen edge disjointness and this family's frozen count; the B8 and A7 #915 snapshots are documented reciprocally, and no earlier frozen body changes.

Public source (fg_edge_count follow-up): GTBase.finite_graph.fg_edge_count, an sgraph -> nat count equal to the edge count, is enrolled as an immutable repository source pinned at ae0e605. It now unfolds to GTBase.common.edge_count; fg_edges is unchanged and equals E(G) (fg_edgesE, adapted from C1), so the former #|fg_edges G| equals the canonical (card_fg_edges). Its frozen copy is GTBase.migration.edge_count.Legacy.fg_edge_count. The complete closure is five rows (Extremal X143, X180, X207; GTMisc X128, X139) through ten intermediate predicates, all frozen at ae0e605 over that copy, with every density, expansion and arithmetic guard and every quantifier unchanged. X180Original is the 9e03072 row over C1's frozen capacity predicate and the frozen average-degree chain; C1's X180 snapshot is documented reciprocally.

B10 history (follow-up on the private merge with B10's integration e0338c4): XE2CycleOriginal is the complete pre-A7/B4/B10 #767 chain and row over this family's frozen count and B10's complete pre-B4/B10 chain; the B10 and A7 snapshots are documented reciprocally and no earlier frozen body changes.
